title: Integrate >=3 more approved sources; scale to >=5,000 deceased persons
context: M1 proved the pipeline with one census batch. M3 scales by integrating at least 3 additional approved public-domain source collections (e.g., NARA immigration/naturalization records, military service/pension files, Chronicling America obituaries) to reach at least 5,000 deceased-only sourced Person records. Each new source must pass the full license and privacy gate before extraction begins. All M1 quality guarantees — 100% provenance, 100% evidence rationale, deceased-only, fresh citation audit >=95%, fresh deceased audit 100%/zero living — must be maintained across the expanded corpus.
objective: Integrate at least 3 additional approved public-domain source collections into the corpus, running each through the full extraction pipeline, to reach at least 5,000 deceased-only sourced Person records with 100% provenance, 100% evidence rationale, a fresh stratified citation audit still >=95%, and a fresh deceased-determination audit still 100%/zero living.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 new source collections integrated (beyond the M1 census batch), each with an approved sources/allowlist.yml entry before extraction began.
Total corpus reaches at least 5,000 deceased-only sourced Person records across all integrated sources.
100% of assertions across all new sources carry a resolvable page/image-level provenance link and a GPS evidence rationale.
A fresh stratified citation audit (min 200 assertions per new source; independent auditor) still achieves >=95% pass rate.
A fresh deceased-determination audit across the expanded corpus confirms 100% correct classification, zero living persons.
All new source integrations pass all CI gates before PR submission.
Integration summary committed with: source list, per-source record counts, deceased/excluded/suppressed totals, and fresh audit results.
output: corpus/ directory expanded with >=3 new source batch subdirectories; integration-summary.md updated, committed via PR.
